members.text: Good morning everyone, this is the weekly update for the desktop release. We finished the packaging work for the three Linux formats on Tuesday and the builds are green. The installer now checks the free disk space before it downloads the speech model. On the recording side we fixed the bug where a muted microphone produced an empty file. The new level meter is in the main window and it responds within a few frames. We also cut the start-up time by loading the model in the background. Translations for all five languages are complete and reviewed by native speakers.

The remaining work is mostly polish and a few accessibility fixes in the settings dialog. For next week the plan is simple. We will run the full test matrix on the release candidate and collect feedback from the internal testers before we decide on the final date.
One more thing before we move on. Please file every crash you see, even the ones that look familiar, so we can track them properly.
